code: local W=workspace:FindFirstChild("FantasySurvivalWorld") local seen={} local o={} for _,m in ipairs(W:GetChildren()) do if m:IsA("Model") then local a=m:GetAttributes() local key=tostring(a.Species or a.MeadowWildlife or a.EnemyType or a.MobType or "") if key~="" or typeof(a.EnemyHealth)=="number" then seen[key]=(seen[key] or 0)+1 if seen[key]==1 then local p=m:GetPivot().Position local at={} for k,v in pairs(a) do table.insert(at,k.."="..tostring(v):sub(1,24)) end table.sort(at) table.insert(o,key.." @"..math.floor(p.X)..","..math.floor(p.Z).." name="..m.Name.." :: "..table.concat(at," ")) end end end end local c={} for k,v in pairs(seen) do table.insert(c,k.."x"..v) end return table.concat(c," ").."\n"..table.concat(o,"\n")
